page.overview:
Who is Travis Willingham?

Travis Willingham is a fictionalized version of voice actor Travis Willingham for Taliesin Jaffe's one-shots, and . This version of Travis Willingham was played by Travis Willingham.

The Vampiric form of Travis Willingham shares a majority of his appearance from his real life counterpart. The only difference is his red eyes and vampiric canines jutting from his upper jaw.
